name: Witch House
places: online music blogs (coined by music journalists to describe a loose cluster of acts)
garments: inverted crosses and triangles as graphic motifs

media.title: Salem (band)
media.note: one of the acts most cited as central to the term's coining

reacts_against: legible branding — witch house acts often used intentionally unpronounceable symbol-based names, extending into a visual language built on illegibility and dread.

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Triangles (△), crosses (✝), Unicode symbols, occult imagery, distorted visuals, lo-fi aesthetics
wiki_facts.key_colours: Black, desaturated colors, dark red, purple, blue
wiki_facts.key_values: Occultism, surrealism, nocturnal themes, horror, dark atmospheres, DIY ethos

findings: dark — about 85% of the measured color across 6 wiki images is below mid-lightness
mostly muted — about 82% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from Aesthetics Wiki photos as photographed and displayed on screen; actual garments and materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
